_comment: Persistent campaign rules (docs/PERSISTENT_RPG_DESIGN.md). Gold is one currency in two wallets: the castle treasury and the expedition purse. Essence is the one rare material.

start.note: A new campaign: treasury gold, stored potions and the castle services open from the start.

expedition.note: Gold the party carries out of the castle (the old run's starting gold, so merchant balance is unchanged).

outcomes.note: What returns to the castle. Equipment found is always kept; relics found always enter the relic collection; HP, rest upgrades and drafted cards reset.

deck.note: Prepared deck rules per sister. Cards must belong to the sister and to her primary or secondary specialization. Secondary cards are capped and appear in rewards at reduced weight.

card_upgrade.note: Upgrade Workshop: permanent upgrade of one collection copy (treasury gold).

refinement.note: Blacksmith: refining an item id improves every copy. Each level adds per_level to every stat the item already has (an item without Max HP gains none). Level 2 costs price x price_step.

specializations.note: Training Hall: unlocking a playable specialization adds its starting cards to the sister's collection.

apothecary.note: Potion belt upgrades bought once each, in order.
